clarification_questions.question: Do you manufacture the garments, or only trade in them?

exclusion_notes.reason: 46411 is wholesale trade of textiles — use 14101 only if you actually manufacture the garments
13921 covers made-up textile articles like curtains and bed linen, not wearable garments

classification_confidence.rationale: Garment manufacturing maps cleanly to 14101; the main risk is confusing manufacturing with trading.

ai.plain_rationale: NIC 14101 is the activity code for manufacturing textile garments and clothing accessories. You use it when registering with MCA or on the MSME (Udyam) portal — it describes what your business does, not what you sell. If you only buy and resell garments without making them, you need a wholesale or retail trade code instead. NIC codes carry no GST rate; for tax, use the HSN code of the garments you produce.
ai.regulatory_citation: National Industrial Classification 2008 (MoSPI), Division 14, Class 1410, Sub-class 14101.
